title: create-key input
description: Store an API key from its id and the SHA-256 (hex) of the whole key string 'dnsapi_<id>_<secret>', where secret is 32 random bytes in lowercase base32 without padding. The secret never reaches the action. From a shell, use bin/create-key instead

allowlist.description: IP addresses or CIDR networks the key may be used from; empty for any

expires.description: ISO 8601 date-time after which the key is refused; null for never

restrict.description: Limit the key to some records: a preset ('acme': _acme-challenge and _acme-challenge.* TXT records), or name patterns relative to the zone (* and ? wildcards, as in dnshelper's rules) and record types; null for every record
